module: Node "Save Data" (once_instant, color file). Saves simple data to a file reusable between sessions. Input: file (name without extension); the custom input pins (types string, number, bool, any, table, vec3, quat, color) are written as keys of the file via modules.file:write.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

init.desc: Enables pin saving and custom input pins.

workOnce.desc: Writes to the file the value of each input pin except flow, reset and file.
